question: Why did Hardware revenue drop so sharply from Q2 to Q3 2025?

sql_attempts.sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-06-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) AS q2_2025_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-09-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) AS q3_2025_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-06-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-09-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_drop FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE p.category = 'Hardware' AND o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-09-30' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY revenue_drop DESC LIMIT 500

answer: Assuming Hardware revenue refers to completed orders across all products in the category, the sharp drop from Q2 to Q3 2025 occurred because revenue fell across all 9 Hardware products. The largest declines were driven by Lattice Ridge (ID 9), which dropped by $354,960.23 (from $482,955.27 to $127,995.04), Cascade Beacon (ID 1), which fell by $323,026.77 (from $459,070.15 to $136,043.38), and Nimbus Quartz (ID 6), which dropped by $287,702.48 (from $404,436.93 to $116,734.45).
caveats: The analysis is based strictly on completed orders within the Hardware category during Q2 and Q3 2025.
